user.title: XiaoDu Reverse
user.description: Choose how to sign in. Account + password is recommended: the integration can refresh the credential automatically.

login.title: Baidu account login
login.description:
Sign in with the Baidu account bound to the XiaoDu app.

BAIDUID can be left empty; the integration fetches it automatically.

If Baidu asks for SMS verification, the next step offers "Send code" and a code field.

cookie.title: Cookie login
cookie.description: Open {cookie_url} in a browser and sign in to XiaoDu smart home, then copy the `BDUSS` cookie value from Developer Tools → Application → Cookies.

device.title: Select devices
device.description: Select the XiaoDu appliances to bring into Home Assistant.

sms_code.description:
{detail}

The code is only used for this login.

error.login_failed: Login failed — check the account and password.
error.login_blocked: Baidu risk control blocked this login. Try again later, or use cookie login.
error.verify_required: Baidu treats this as a new-device login and wants a second-factor check, but offered no SMS entry point. Use the "BDUSS cookie" option instead: sign in to the XiaoDu web page, then copy the BDUSS value from Developer Tools → Application → Cookies.
error.captcha_required: This login needs an image captcha. Try again later, or sign in to the XiaoDu web page first and use cookie login.
error.invalid_auth: The BDUSS cookie is invalid or expired.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the XiaoDu cloud. Check the network and retry.
error.resend_too_soon: Please wait for the countdown before resending the code.
error.sms_send_failed: Failed to send the SMS code, please try again later.
error.session_expired: The verification session expired, please go back and sign in again.

abort.no_house_found: No home was found for this account.
abort.no_device_found: No device was found in this home.

relogin.title: Sign in again
relogin.description:
Sign in again with the Baidu account to refresh the credentials.

BAIDUID can be left empty.

If Baidu asks for SMS verification, the next step offers "Send code" and a code field; the code can be resent after 60 seconds.
